# Holos · leads seen from each seat

Each lead is one real system. Earth’s data fix part of its orbit; the seeding picks the rest. Every claim a seat makes about it is tested against every orbit Earth’s data permit. Robust: true for all of them. Seeded: true for the orbit the seeding picked. FAIL: true for none.

**6 robust · 12 seeded · 0 FAIL**

## Systems

### Delta Pavonis · a cold giant, at least 37 Years round
An astrometric pull with only a faint trend toward and away (2021 astrometry; Laliotis et al. 2023). Its orbit nearly faces Sol.
Seeded pole: 19° from Sol’s line, turned 51° from the side facing Kesh.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sol | Earth · a pull across the sky, a faint tug | 0° | tilted 19°, 33% of its tug | shows at most half its tug | seeded |
| Kesh | Lodestar · heavier than it pulls | 21° | tilted 17°, 29% of its tug | shows at most half its tug | seeded |
| Hael | Warden · seen from the side, its pull still building | 107° | tilted 90°, 100% of its tug | shows nearly all its tug | seeded |

### Epsilon Indi · Epsilon Indi Ab
JWST imaged it: 6.3 Jupiter masses, about 28 AU out, tilted about 99° to Sol’s line (Matthews et al. 2024). A clear detection.
Seeded pole: 87° from Sol’s line, turned 33° from the side facing Veyra.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Veyra | Ember · seen directly | 142° | 10.06″ from its star at most, 1.65× Earth’s brightness | clear of the glare, and bright enough | robust |
| Veyra | Ember · a sway to weigh it against | 142° | tilted 62°, 88% of its tug | shows at least half the tug Earth sees | robust |
| Hael | Ash · seen directly | 137° | 6.46″ from its star at most, 0.68× Earth’s brightness | clear of the glare, and bright enough | robust |
| Hael | Ash · a sway to weigh it against | 137° | tilted 84°, 100% of its tug | shows at least half the tug Earth sees | robust |

### Tau Ceti · four candidate worlds
Four wobbles under 1 m/s (Feng et al. 2017), inside a dust belt tilted about 35° (MacGregor et al. 2016). Taken as one plane.
Seeded pole: 32° from Sol’s line, turned 327° from the side facing Kesh.

| Seat | Claim | Off Sol’s line | What it sees | Needs | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Kesh | Chaff · wobbles too small to trust | 61° | tilted 36°, 59% of its tug | shows 0.7 to 1.5 times the tug Earth sees | seeded |

### 82 Eridani · three hot worlds
Three worlds of a few Earth masses, found by their tug (Pepe et al. 2011). Tilt unknown.
Seeded pole: 125° from Sol’s line, turned 240° from the side facing Hael.

| Seat | Claim | Off Sol’s line | What it sees | Needs | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Hael | Brood · three hot worlds | 87° | tilted 64°, 90% of its tug | shows 0.7 to 1.5 times the tug Earth sees | seeded |

### Beta Hydri · no body
The drift tracks the star’s own spot cycle (2012 and 2023 studies). No body, so nothing changes with the view.
